_comment: Per-craft flying manners of the AI pilot (FlightProfile). Keys: clearance_m minimum height above the ground, look_ahead_s how far ahead along the path the ground is read, react_s the craft's pitch response time, max_bank_deg bank in a hard turn, bank_per_rad bank per rad of heading error, max_climb_deg / max_dive_deg flight path limits, climb_per_m the climb asked for per metre of height error (a jet: rad of nose, i.e. that share of its speed; a hover craft: that share of its vertical speed), edge_margin_s seconds of flight kept between the craft and the map edge, dive_clearance_m the height over the ground a strafing dive (FlyerAI, only on its final approach to the target) may go down to; everywhere else clearance_m is a floor. A craft takes the first rule whose pack and any name fragment match its vehicle id; the style default fills the rest.
